title: Pack + clean {origin} apartment
description: Pack remaining belongings; deep clean per lease requirements; keep cleaning receipts if hiring a service. Photo/video documentation supports deposit recovery.

title: Move day · drive + inspect {destination} unit
description: {origin} → {destination}: check the distance and plan an overnight stop if the drive is a long one. On arrival: pick up keys, document move-in condition with photos before unloading.

title: STATUTORY · tax residency note
description: Note the date you established residency in your new state for next April's tax returns (a move between states can mean a part-year return in each). The other statutory deadlines (driver's license, vehicle registration, voter re-registration) live as Address Updates so they each get their own deadline pill.
